nodes.description: Mapping uint kind => Gem struct storing entropy, difficulty, multiplier, gemsPerMine, crafter and manager; core storage mutated by create/update*/craft mine paths.
Mapping address => uint mining nonce, incremented in mine() and consumed as entropy inside luck().
Global counter of created gem kinds, incremented in _create(); used as the upper bound for every `kind < gemCount` check.
Seed derived from blockhash(block.number-1) in start(); consumed by airdrop() to decide gem drops.
Mapping kind => amount crafted by the owner; incremented before the external GEM.craft call in craft().
Mapping NFT id => claimed flag set in _claim() to prevent double claiming.
Immutable IERC721 reference used by _claim() to verify token ownership.
Immutable ProvablyRareGem reference; all craft/mint/entropy interactions go through it.
Immutable first gem kind id created by this crafter; base offset for airdrop computations.
External function creating a new gem kind after validating difficulty, gemsPerMine, multiplier and manager.
nonReentrant mining entry point: computes luck, bumps nonce, scales difficulty (diff*multiplier/10000+1) and mints gemsPerMine gems.
Sets gem entropy; restricted to the gem manager or crafter.
Updates gem name/color; restricted to the gem manager.
Updates difficulty/multiplier/gemsPerMine with bounds checks; restricted to the gem manager.
Clears manager and pendingManager for a batch of kinds; restricted to the current gem manager.
Sets the gem crafter for a batch of kinds; restricted to the gem manager.
Sets pendingManager for a batch of kinds; restricted to the current gem manager.
Two-step manager handover acceptance; requires msg.sender == pendingManager.
nonReentrant crafter mint; caller must equal gems[kind].crafter and mints realAmount to an arbitrary `to` address.
View function hashing chainid, entropy, contract, msg.sender, kind, nonce and salt to derive a mining difficulty value.
Internal gem kind registration: increments gemCount and writes the Gem struct.
Builds the on-chain SVG/base64 metadata JSON for a gem kind.
onlyOwner one-time initializer that sets hashseed from blockhash and pushes the seed into GEM entropy.
nonReentrant onlyOwner crafting of a gem kind; updates crafted[] then calls GEM.craft and only afterwards enforces the 10% supply cap.
View helper deriving the deterministic list of gem kinds an NFT id receives from hashseed.
nonReentrant NFT-owner claim entry point that delegates to _claim.
nonReentrant batch claim looping over ids and calling _claim for each.
Internal claim: verifies NFT ownership, marks claimed, computes airdrop and calls GEM.craft four times for msg.sender.
Deploys the crafter, stores NFT/GEM/FIRST_KIND and creates the ten initial gem types.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, mint recipients, nonce accounting and the luck() hash preimage.
keccak256 over chainid/entropy/address(this)/msg.sender/kind/nonce/salt used as mining randomness.
Unsigned arithmetic in mine(): difficulty = (diff * multiplier) / 10000 + 1, bounded only by a prior manual overflow check.
ERC1155 _mint/_safeTransfer acceptance check performs a callback into the recipient contract via onERC1155Received.
hashseed = blockhash(block.number - 1): miner-influenced, only usable for the previous 256 blocks.
airdrop drop decision from keccak256(hashseed, offset, id): fully predictable once hashseed is public and the same for every NFT.
External GEM.craft call in LOOTGemCrafter.craft executed before the supply-cap require, violating checks-effects-interactions ordering.
External GEM.craft calls inside the _claim loop; ownership and claimed status are checked before the loop.
Caller-supplied gem kind being mined.
Caller-supplied mining salt fed into luck().
Gem kind to mint in ProvablyRareGem.craft.
Amount to mint; zero means gemsPerMine is used.
Recipient of crafted gems.
Gem kind hashed inside luck().
Salt hashed inside luck().
Initial gem difficulty supplied to create() and bounded by 2**128.
NFT token id being claimed.
Array of NFT token ids claimed in a batch.
Local result of luck(kind, salt) used in the salt check.
Cached gems[kind].difficulty read before scaling.
Resolved mint amount (amount or gemsPerMine when amount == 0).
Number of gem kinds already assigned in the airdrop loop (capped at 4).
Fixed-size array of four gem kinds returned by airdrop(id).
Loop counter used to seed the entropy of the ten FIRST_KIND gems.

edges.reason: msg.sender is incremented in nonce[msg.sender] and used as the mint recipient in mine().
updateEntropy authorizes via gems[kind].manager == msg.sender || crafter == msg.sender.
updateGemInfo requires gems[kind].manager == msg.sender.
updateMiningData requires gems[kind].manager == msg.sender.
renounceManager requires gems[kind].manager == msg.sender per kind.
updateCrafter requires gems[kind].manager == msg.sender per kind.
transferManager requires gems[kind].manager == msg.sender per kind.
acceptManager requires gems[kind].pendingManager == msg.sender before granting manager rights.
craft requires gems[kind].crafter == msg.sender to authorize arbitrary minting.
msg.sender is part of the keccak256 preimage in luck(), tying mining to the caller.
start() is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender().
craft() is guarded by onlyOwner and also passes msg.sender as the gem recipient.
claim() ultimately requires msg.sender == NFT.ownerOf(id) inside _claim.
_claim performs the msg.sender == NFT.ownerOf(id) ownership check and mints to msg.sender.
craft reads gems[kind].crafter and gems[kind].gemsPerMine.
mine reads and writes gems[kind].difficulty.
luck reads gems[kind].entropy.
_create writes the whole Gem struct into gems[kind].
updateEntropy writes gems[kind].entropy.
updateGemInfo writes gems[kind].name and color.
updateMiningData writes difficulty, multiplier and gemsPerMine.
renounceManager writes manager and pendingManager to address(0).
updateCrafter writes gems[kind].crafter.
transferManager writes gems[kind].pendingManager.
acceptManager writes pendingManager and manager for each kind.
uri reads gems[kind].color and gems[kind].name for metadata rendering.
mine increments nonce[msg.sender] before minting.
luck includes nonce[msg.sender] in the hash preimage.
_create increments gemCount via gemCount++.
start assigns hashseed = blockhash(block.number - 1).
airdrop requires hashseed != 0 and uses it as the drop seed.
craft accumulates crafted[kind] += amount.
_claim sets claimed[id] = true before the external gem crafting calls.
_claim calls NFT.ownerOf(id) for the ownership check.
craft calls GEM.craft and GEM.totalSupply.
_claim calls GEM.craft for each airdropped kind.
airdrop initializes kinds to FIRST_KIND and offsets by FIRST_KIND + offset.
_claim consumes airdrop results which are derived from FIRST_KIND.
start loops over FIRST_KIND + offset when pushing entropy.
constructor assigns the immutable NFT reference.
constructor assigns the immutable GEM reference.
constructor assigns FIRST_KIND = _gem.gemCount().
create() delegates the state mutation to _create().
mine() calls luck(kind, salt) to determine the mining result.
_claim calls airdrop(id) to obtain the four gem kinds.
claim() delegates the whole claim logic to _claim(id).
multiClaim loops over the ids array calling _claim for each id.
mine() mints to msg.sender, which may be a contract implementing onERC1155Received and re-entering.
craft() mints to an arbitrary `to` address, triggering the ERC1155 receiver acceptance callback.
LOOTGemCrafter.craft calls GEM.craft (external) after updating crafted[] but before the supply-cap require.
_claim performs four external GEM.craft calls in a loop after setting claimed[id] and checking ownership.
luck() derives its result from keccak256 of caller-influenced, partially predictable data.
mine multiplies difficulty by multiplier and divides by 10000 before adding 1.
start() derives hashseed from a miner/validator-influenced block value, making the seed block-dependent.
airdrop decides drops with keccak256(hashseed, offset, id) % chances[offset], a deterministic function of public data.
mine.kind parameter bounds the gems[kind] accesses and the difficulty update.
mine.salt parameter is forwarded to luck(kind, salt).
craft.kind selects which gem struct is read and minted.
craft.amount determines realAmount when non-zero.
craft.to is the recipient passed to the internal _mint.
luck.kind is hashed and used to fetch gems[kind].entropy.
luck.salt is hashed into the luck preimage.
create.difficulty is range-checked (<= 2**128) before being stored.
claim.id is the NFT token id forwarded to _claim.
multiClaim.ids is iterated and each element forwarded to _claim.
mine stores luck(kind, salt) into the local val.
mine caches gems[kind].difficulty into the local diff.
local diff is the multiplicand in (diff * gems[kind].multiplier) / 10000 + 1.
craft computes realAmount = amount == 0 ? gems[kind].gemsPerMine : amount.
airdrop increments and compares count against 4 inside its loop.
_claim stores airdrop(id) into the fixed-size kinds array before minting.
start uses the loop counter offset to call GEM.updateEntropy for ten kinds.
